# Venmo Help Center

> > Comprehensive support documentation for Venmo's peer-to-peer payments, debit card services, account management, and security features.

Venmo Help Center provides official support documentation covering account setup, payment transfers, wallet management, debit card operations, dispute resolution, and tax compliance. The site serves users of Venmo's mobile payment platform and associated financial products including the Venmo Debit Card powered by Mastercard and The Bancorp Bank.

## Key Topics

- Venmo Debit Card
- Payments & Transfers
- Account Management
- Dispute Resolution
- Security & Privacy
- Fraud Prevention
- Transaction History
- Unauthorized Charges
- Form 1099-K
- Tax Reporting
- Payment Issues
- Scams
- Wallet
- Customer Support
- Getting Started

## Core Support Topics

- [Venmo Help Center and Support](https://help.venmo.com/cs/home): Main help center homepage with FAQs and support for accounts, payments, and security
- [Accounts, Profiles & Settings](https://help.venmo.com/cs/topic/accounts_settings): Help documentation for Venmo account management, profiles, and settings
- [Payments & Transfers](https://help.venmo.com/cs/topic/payments_transfers): Support guide for Venmo payments, transfers, and money movement features
- [Getting Started](https://help.venmo.com/cs/topic/get_started): Beginner guide for getting started with Venmo account setup and payments

## Security, Privacy & Fraud Prevention

- [Security & Privacy](https://help.venmo.com/cs/topic/security_privacy): Security and privacy guidance for Venmo account safety and fraud prevention
- [Common Scams on Venmo](https://help.venmo.com/cs/articles/common-scams-on-venmo-vhel167): Educational guide on common Venmo scams and fraud prevention strategies
- [What do I do if there's an unauthorized charge on my account?](https://help.venmo.com/cs/articles/what-do-i-do-if-theres-an-unauthorized-charge-on-my-account-vhel309): Guide for reporting unauthorized Venmo account charges and fraud

## Debit Card & Purchases

- [Wallet](https://help.venmo.com/cs/topic/wallet): Help for Venmo wallet management, payment methods, and debit card features
- [Buying & Selling with Venmo](https://help.venmo.com/cs/topic/buying_selling): Help for buying and selling with Venmo debit card and online purchases
- [Venmo Debit Card Shipping & Arrival Time](https://help.venmo.com/cs/articles/venmo-debit-card-shipping--arrival-time-vhel166): Information on Venmo Debit Card shipping timelines and delivery
- [What do I do if there's a problem with my online purchase?](https://help.venmo.com/cs/articles/what-do-i-do-if-theres-a-problem-with-my-online-purchase-vhel307): Troubleshooting guide for declined Venmo online purchases and refunds
- [What should I do if I am not satisfied with a Venmo Debit Card purchase?](https://help.venmo.com/cs/articles/what-should-i-do-if-i-am-not-satisfied-with-a-venmo-debit-card-purchase-vhel287): Help for Venmo Mastercard debit card purchase disputes and refunds

## Disputes & Troubleshooting

- [Disputes](https://help.venmo.com/cs/topic/disputes): Dispute resolution guide for Venmo debit card and payment issues
- [Opening a Dispute](https://help.venmo.com/cs/articles/opening-a-dispute-vhel113): Instructions for opening disputes on Venmo debit card and credit card transactions
- [Troubleshooting](https://help.venmo.com/cs/topic/troubleshooting): Troubleshooting guide for Venmo account issues, payment problems, and disputes

## Tax Reporting & Compliance

- [Tax Center](https://help.venmo.com/cs/topic/tax_center): Venmo tax reporting and compliance documentation for Form 1099-K
- [Venmo Tax FAQ](https://help.venmo.com/cs/articles/venmo-tax-faq-vhel137): FAQ about Venmo tax reporting, 1099-K forms, and IRS requirements

## Account Types & Features

- [Business Profiles & Charity Profiles](https://help.venmo.com/cs/topic/biz_charity_profile): Documentation for Venmo business and charity profile account types
- [Transaction History](https://help.venmo.com/cs/articles/transaction-history-vhel281): How-to guide for viewing and downloading Venmo transaction history

## Optional

- [Cancel Payment](https://help.venmo.com/cs/articles/cancel-payment-vhel148): How-to guide for canceling Venmo payments and pending transactions
